family_2_coupled_entry_point.case: F2 the discarded least-squares residual, measured against the slope error
family_2_coupled_entry_point.note: the relative residual tracks the slope error across four orders of magnitude and is returned by the very lstsq call the module already makes, then dropped by `coef, *_`. Reported as evidence that a guard is available, NOT as a patch.

family_2_coupled_entry_point.exception: ValueError: u_x_at_origin: the origin fit window (r in (0.13895, 0.1)) holds 0 of 8 radial nodes, fewer than the 2 required for the two-parameter fit. This grid does not resolve the origin neighbourhood (r_min=0.01); refine the radial grid, widen r_window, or lower r_min. Fitting anyway would return a fabricated finite value.
family_2_coupled_entry_point.note: run() computes its renorm targets from odd_field_x_slope BEFORE the first rhs call, so the fabricated value is latched first; the sibling guard then raises on the first rhs. The fabricated target is reported here because it is what run() would divide by if the guard were ever relaxed.

family_2_guard_structure.note: u_x_at_origin's window (r<0.1, 2 params) is a strict SUBSET of odd_field_x_slope's (r<0.4, 3 params); both mask on index>=3. So an EMPTY odd-fit window forces an empty sibling window and the sibling's leg-99 guard always raises first. The surviving gap is exactly the rank-deficient-but-nonempty case, and in it BOTH fit nodes necessarily lie at r<0.1.

family_2_widest_surviving_gap.attribution: the resolved control on the SAME fields passes at 2.9443160057025202e-05, so the error is attributable to the rank-deficient fit window, not to the adequacy of the (r, r^3, r^5) basis

family_5_reduction_information_loss.case: F5 angular DST-I round trip from_modes(to_modes(f)) on a random field
family_5_reduction_information_loss.note: S @ S = (M/2) I, so the angular transform is an exact bijection ON GRID FIELDS. There is no 2/3 mask and no truncation, so the leg 129/188 dealias-annihilation mechanism (an input field the mask sends to zero while the module reports on it) has no site in this module. This control CAN report the other answer: a mask would show up here as a finite round-trip loss.
